title: Record a clinical session
summary: From the record: Create → Clinical session. Procedure, diagnosis, notes, plan for the next session and treatments performed.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: Everything that can be created for this patient: clinical, financial and scheduling.

steps.title: Clinical session
steps.details: Opens the clinical history and the new session form.

steps.title: Procedure
steps.details: What was done in the session.

steps.title: Next session plan
steps.details: It's shown to the doctor at the next appointment.

steps.title: Treatments
steps.details: Check the ones from the quote that were done today: they're ready to invoice.

steps.title: Attachments
steps.details: X-rays, photos or studies from this session.

steps.title: Save the session
steps.details: It stays on the patient's timeline.
